dispatch_metadata.title: Apple AGX G18 Darwin Host Driver Boundary & Dispatch Architecture

primary_accelerator.description: Hardware driver managing G18 (PI_300) register spaces, power domains, USC clusters, and RTBuddy firmware coordination

iokit_family.description: Common GPU framework managing memory mappings, resource lifetimes, command queues, and IOKit userclient dispatch

rtbuddy_firmware_kext.description: Coprocessor bridge initializing and managing RTBuddy RTKit OS on GPU ASC cores

core_cpp_classes.responsibilities: Central hardware coordinator; manages clock and power gating, SAPT interrupts, frequency/power transfer tables, CSC and UMA descriptors
Coordinates 3D rasterization, tile allocation, and fragment work. Implements virtual void AGX3DChannelSKSM::submitBuffer(IOGPUCommandDescriptor *)
Coordinates GPGPU compute and ray tracing workloads. Implements virtual void AGXCLChannelSKSM::submitBuffer(IOGPUCommandDescriptor *)
Manages bidirectional RTKit endpoint communication and firmware event ring draining with RTBuddy Core 1
Base Mach message trap handler, implements memory mappings, shared events, and legacy command submission
Hardware-specialized userclient exposing PMPDoorbell aperture and direct submission ring buffer configuration

selectors.description: Allocates hardware command queue, creates shared ring buffers, and maps PMPDoorbell page
Flushes pending work and deallocates hardware command queue resources
Allocates GPU virtual memory, texture backing, or parameter buffers via IOGPUMemory
Legacy fallback path: submits command buffers via IOKit kernel Mach message trap
Asynchronously signals a speculative late-evaluation event from userland
Queries resolution status of a speculative late-evaluation event
Fast trap for atomic signaling of an IOSurfaceSharedEvent monotonic counter
Fast trap for suspending execution until an IOSurfaceSharedEvent reaches threshold
Creates specialized direct-to-storage I/O queue for Fast Resource Loading (Metal 3.2)
Enqueues asynchronous file-to-GPU memory stream requests bypassing CPU paging

memory_mapping_types.name: IOGPU_CLIENT_MEMORY_COMMAND_RING
memory_mapping_types.description: Shared circular command descriptor ring buffer (1024 entries x 64 bytes)

memory_mapping_types.name: IOGPU_CLIENT_MEMORY_STATUS_PAGE
memory_mapping_types.description: Hardware timestamp completion status page written by RTBuddy firmware

memory_mapping_types.name: IOGPU_CLIENT_MEMORY_DOORBELL
memory_mapping_types.description: Hardware PMPDoorbell MMIO trigger page mapped into user process

stage_2_dart_protection.mechanism: Device Address Resolution Table (DART) Stage-2 hardware IOMMU
stage_2_dart_protection.isolation: GPU translations are bound to process DSID; illegal access generates kAGFIFirmwareEventTypeChannelError

io_shared_lock.mechanism: Ticket spinlock with owner tracking and contention fallback

kernel_lock_primitives: fFenceLock: Protects IOFence creation and signaling callbacks
fSQDoorbellLock: Serializes doorbell allocation and hardware queue register updates
fRequestProcessLock: Governs channel queue scheduling and preemptive dispatch
fGARTCollectorLock: Controls dynamic memory deallocation and page table reclamation
mClientInfoLock: Synchronizes userclient lifecycle and resource registration

legacy_iokit_path.mechanism: Mach message IPC trap (io_connect_method) -> XNU Kernel -> AGX3DChannelSKSM -> Doorbell

apple_metal_direct_path.mechanism: Lock-free ring write -> Memory Barrier -> Atomic 64-bit PMPDoorbell Store -> RTBuddy Core 1
